metadata.title: AI Consultancy & Implementation | Vocom AI
metadata.description: Vocom AI provides AI consultancy, audits, and enterprise AI solutions, identifying inefficiencies and designing automation systems with measurable ROI.

attributes.text: Vocom AI partners with business leaders who see AI as a growth lever, not just hype.
Proven with founders, operators, and enterprise teams driving measurable business efficiency and revenue.
We uncover real, revenue-driving AI opportunities inside your operations, embedding with your team to find them quickly.
Implement voice, chat, or internal agents who handle real work, integrated right into your systems.
Automate workflows, connect the dots between tools, and deliver custom solutions built for your exact business context.
Deploy pre-built AI agents, workflows, and tools proven across industries. Fast to launch, easy to adapt.
Start with a template, add your workflows, or ask us to tailor solutions for true fit.
Built on your data, systems, and requirements. We partner with your stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable automations and bespoke AI agents.
Every solution is robust, enterprise-ready, and tightly integrated, never generic.

attributes.$control__content: Discover & diagnose: uncover real opportunities and pain points.
Build, test, and roll out practical AI solutions fast.
Connect, train, and scale with your data, continuously improving outcomes.

attributes.text: Sync your work with a tools:
We plug into your business and map real pain points
Identify practical AI solutions that actually work
Straight answers to the questions we hear most.

attributes.$control__question: What does the AI audit involve?
attributes.$control__answer: We plug into your business and map real pain points, identify practical AI solutions, and deliver an ROI calculation and an implementation roadmap. Audits start from $5,000.

attributes.$control__question: What is the difference between the AI Marketplace and custom AI solutions?
attributes.$control__answer: The Marketplace offers pre-built agents, workflows and tools proven across industries, quick to launch and easy to adapt. Custom solutions are built on your own data, systems and requirements when a template is not the right fit.

attributes.$control__question: What kinds of AI agents can you deploy?
attributes.$control__answer: Voice, chat and internal agents that handle real work, such as customer support and sales operations, integrated into the systems you already use.
Book a demo for a free personalised walkthrough and ROI assessment, or book an AI audit. For enterprise projects, contact sales to discuss tailored solutions and full implementation.
